title: Outbound provider requests connect to the address the SSRF guard vetted
statement: resolve_allowed resolves an outbound URL once on the event loop's resolver (never a blocking socket.getaddrinfo), applies the API-004 address policy to every answer, and returns the vetted addresses. The intelligence client sends every Glassnode request through PinnedTransport, which connects to a vetted address while keeping the Host header and TLS SNI on the original hostname, and refuses any request for an origin it did not vet.
failure_mode: The guard resolved the host, then httpx resolved it again, so a DNS-rebinding answer (public then private) passed the check and the request reached an internal address; the synchronous getaddrinfo also blocked the event loop on every request. The API-004 tests injected a resolver into the guard alone and never followed the request to the connection, so nothing compared the vetted address with the connected one; the deciding test now does.
